bib.title: Exploring the Trade-Offs: Quantization Methods, Task Difficulty, and Model Size in Large Language Models From Edge to Giant

question: How do four post-training quantization methods (GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, FP8) affect instruction-tuned models from 1B to 405B across 13 benchmarks and an LLM-judged chat benchmark?
contributions: Evaluation of 12 instruction-tuned models (1B-405B) under GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant and FP8 on OpenLLM Leaderboard v1 and v2 tasks plus MT-Bench
Analysis by model size, method, task difficulty, and MT-Bench category with manual inspection of GPT-4 judgements

method.summary: Applies off-the-shelf PTQ tools (AutoGPTQ, llmcompressor, AutoRound, AutoAWQ) to 12 Hugging Face instruction-tuned models, then evaluates with lm-eval (Leaderboard v1/v2 tasks) and FastChat MT-Bench (GPT-4 judge) on a four-server multi-GPU cluster using vLLM or Accelerate. No training.
method.task: Evaluation of quantized LLM accuracy across tasks

datasets.name: MATH-Lvl-5
datasets.source: Hendrycks et al., 2021b; Lewkowycz et al., 2022

datasets.name: NeelNanda/pile-10k
datasets.size: 128 samples x 512 tokens (AutoRound GPTQ, Llama-3.2 and 3.3 AWQ/GPTQ)

datasets.name: Random tokens from tokenizer vocab
datasets.size: 256 sequences x 8,192 tokens (Llama-3.1-8B GPTQ 8/16 and SmoothQuant)

inference.decoding: greedy (lm-eval default; vLLM temperature, top_k, top_p set to greedy defaults)
inference.samples: single run per config; lm-eval seeds: python 0, numpy 1234, torch 1234, few-shot 1234; no repeats or significance tests stated
inference.prompting: Leaderboard v1/v2 few-shot settings per task (ARC 25, HellaSwag 10, TruthfulQA 0, MMLU 5, Winogrande 5, GSM8k 5; BBH 3, GPQA 0, IFEval 0, Math 4, MMLU-PRO 5, MuSR 0)

parameters.GPTQ (llmcompressor): scheme W4A16 or W8A16, targets Linear, ignore lm_head, dampening_frac=0.01, group size 128, symmetric per-channel
parameters.SmoothQuant (llmcompressor): smoothing_strength=0.8 default (0.7 with custom mappings for Llama-3.2), then GPTQModifier W8A8 targets Linear ignore lm_head dampening_frac 0.01, INT8 weights and activations symmetric per-channel
parameters.FP8 (llmcompressor): E4M3, weights and activations per-tensor symmetric static (dynamic false), ignore lm_head
parameters.GPTQ (AutoRound): used for Llama-3.2-1B/3B and Llama-3.3-70B (config not given)

other.serving: vLLM 0.6.6.post1; HF Accelerate 1.2.1 fallback when vLLM unusable
other.package_versions: Transformers 4.47.1, llmcompressor 0.3.1, auto-gptq 0.7.1, autoawq 0.2.7.post3, bitsandbytes 0.45.0, lm_eval 0.4.4

metrics.name: Leaderboard v1 per-task accuracy and Avg.
metrics.definition: acc/acc_norm/mc2 per task, mean of six

metrics.name: Leaderboard v2 per-task normalized score and Avg.
metrics.definition: 100*(raw-lower)/(1-lower), lower=1/num_choices; generative tasks lower=0; mean of six

metrics.name: MT-Bench score
metrics.definition: GPT-4 single-answer grade 0-10 per turn, per category and averaged

metrics.name: Delta vs FP16
metrics.definition: quantized minus FP16, printed in parentheses in tables

baselines: smaller FP16 models of the same family (RQ1)
eval.protocol: One run per model-method pair, greedy decoding, no variance estimate; LLM judge plus manual inspection of selected MT-Bench cases (Appendix C.4, C.5). Hardware: H100-80Gx8, A100-80Gx4, RTX6000-48Gx4, A6000-48Gx4.

availability.data: Colab normalization code linked in D.2; benchmarks are public

evidence.quote: In lm-eval, if no specific settings are provided, decoding defaults to greedy decoding, which we used.

results.claim: Original FP16 accuracy and all GPTQ configs for Llama-3.1-405B were not measured because runtime exceeded 30 days
results.note: Yet Tables 1-2 print an FP16 row for 405B (810 GB). Source of those numbers is not stated.

limits: Single run per configuration, no seeds, error bars or significance tests; many deltas are under 1 point and may be noise.

Calibration data, tools and group sizes differ across rows (AutoGPTQ vs llmcompressor vs AutoRound; different calibration sets), so method and tool effects are confounded; authors say calibration study is out of scope.
Llama-3.1-405B original accuracy and most GPTQ configs not measured (30-day runtime) though FP16 row is printed.
No latency, throughput or memory measurements; storage GB only. Claims about FP8 speed and KV cache halving are asserted, not measured.
GPT-4 judge mis-scores answers (authors show misjudged cases); MT-Bench has only 80 questions (10 per category), and near-ceiling scores for 70B+ hide differences.
Main text and Appendix C.1 disagree on which MT-Bench categories drop most (Coding and STEM vs Coding, Humanities, Extraction); abstract says 13 datasets while Appendix A says 12 plus MT-Bench.
Only Llama, Vicuna, Gemma families; Vicuna and Gemma only get GPTQ and AWQ (no FP8, SmoothQuant). INT4 only for weight-only; no 3-bit or KV-cache quantization evaluated.
Software versions are late 2024 (vLLM 0.6.6, llmcompressor 0.3.1); results may shift with newer kernels.
